description: This file implements the Client class for IPC communication within the Rialto server manager, handling connection setup, RPC calls, event handling, and logging.

classes.name: Client
classes.description: Handles IPC communication with the Rialto session server, including connection, configuration, state management, and event handling.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes IPC connection and subscribes to events.

methods.name: performSetState
methods.description: Sends a request to set the session server state.

methods.name: performSetConfiguration
methods.description: Sends a configuration request to the server.

methods.name: performPing
methods.description: Sends a ping request to the server.

methods.name: setLogLevels
methods.description: Updates log levels on the server.

methods.name: onStateChangedEvent
methods.description: Handles state change events from the server.

methods.name: onAckEvent
methods.description: Handles acknowledgment events from the server.
